## Personality

Gruff, watchful and proud of his city. He welcomes everyone and trusts nobody until they have earned it.

## Story

Brann commands the guards at the great gate and greets every traveller off the Royal Road. He likes to say the road is quiet, until it is not, and lately it is not more often than it used to be.
